description: A software-composition-analysis (SCA) finding: a vulnerable dependency detected by OSS SCA (OSV-Scanner / Trivy) and matched purl→CVE, reusing the giemon VulnMatch model (ADR-2605312330). Mirrors a kotoba VulnMatch entity. Detail leg of a com.etzhayyim.aratame.vulnFinding with category=Dependency. R0 = schema skeleton; R1 = additionalProperties=false + required-field enforcement.

purl.description: Package URL (purl) of the affected component (joins giemon's component */purl, ADR-2605312330).

installedVersion.description: Version present in the inspected dependency manifest.

fixedVersion.description: First non-vulnerable version, if published by the advisory.

advisoryRef.description: OSV / GHSA / NVD advisory URL or id (public source mirror).

manifestPath.description: Path of the dependency manifest the component was read from (static location).
